title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
summary: Grade 10: writing and balancing equations, the main types of reactions, and oxidation and reduction in everyday life.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Balanced equations describe how atoms rearrange in reactions, helping us predict products and control changes like corrosion.

factual: How do you balance an equation?
conceptual: How can we tell what type of reaction has happened?
debatable: Should manufacturers be required to use rust-proof materials in public infrastructure?
